camel_example: aliyun ecs DescribeReservedInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status.1 Active --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 50 --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-z' --InstanceTypeFamily 'ecs.g5' --AllocationType Normal --ReservedInstanceId.1 'ri-bpzhex2ulpzf530000' --OfferingType All_Upfront --Scope Region --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ReservedInstanceName testReservedInstanceName --LockReason security --InstanceType 'ecs.g5.large'
description_en: Queries the list of reserved instances that you have purchased in a specified region. You can filter reserved instances by tags, reserved instance attributes, and other parameters
description_zh: 本接口主要用于查询指定地域下您已经购买的预留实例券信息列表，支持您根据标签、预留实例券属性等参数获取预留实例券详细信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-reserved-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --zone-id cn-hangzhou-z --reserved-instance-name testReservedInstanceName --lock-reason security --instance-type ecs.g5.large --instance-type-family ecs.g5 --scope Region --offering-type All_Upfront --allocation-type Normal --reserved-instance-id ri-bpzhex2ulpzf530000 --status Active --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeReservedInstances

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the reserved instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 预留实例券所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html获取最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the reserved instance list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时的每页行数，最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the reserved instance. The tag key cannot be an empty string and can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http:// or https://.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the specified tag cannot exceed 1,000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count with all specified tags attached cannot exceed 1,000. If the resource count exceeds 1,000, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html operation to query resources
fields.help_zh:
预留实例券的标签键。不允许为空字符串，最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个；如果资源数量超过1000个，请使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html接口进行查询
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the reserved instance. The tag value cannot be an empty string and can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with acs: and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 预留实例券的标签值。不允许为空字符串,最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the instance. This parameter is required and takes effect only when Scope is set to Zone. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25610.html to query the zone list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的可用区编号，当Scope为Zone时生效并且必填。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25610.html获取可用区列表
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the reserved instance.

Only exact match is supported. Fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券名称。

完全匹配，暂不支持模糊查询过滤
parameters.name: reserved_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The lock type. Valid values:

financial: The account has an overdue payment or the service has expired.
security: Locked for security reasons
parameters.help_zh:
锁定类型。取值范围：

financial：账号欠费或服务过期。
security：安全原因
parameters.name: lock_reason

parameters.help_en:
The instance type that the reserved instance can be applied to. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html. 

This is the instance type selected when you purchased the reserved instance. During actual deduction, region-level reserved instances support size-flexible deduction within the same instance family
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券对应的实例规格。取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html。 

购买预留实例券时选择的实例规格，实际抵扣的时候，地域级预留实例券支持同规格组内的不同大小规格换算抵扣
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The instance family that the reserved instance can be applied to. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
parameters.help_zh: 预留实例券对应的实例规格族。取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
parameters.name: instance_type_family

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the reserved instance. Valid values:
         
Region: regional.
Zone: zonal
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券的范围。取值范围：
         
Region：地域级别。
Zone：可用区级别
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The payment type of the reserved instance. Valid values:

No Upfront: no upfront.
Partial Upfront: partial upfront.
All Upfront: all upfront
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券的付款类型。取值范围：

No Upfront：零预付。
Partial Upfront：部分预付。
All Upfront：全预付
parameters.name: offering_type

parameters.help_en:
The allocation type. Valid values:

Normal: queries reserved instances under the current account.
Shared: queries reserved instances that have been shared between the current account and linked accounts.

Default value: Normal
parameters.help_zh:
分配类型。取值范围：

Normal：查询当前账号下的预留实例券。
Shared：查询当前账号下已经建立主子账号共享的预留实例券。

默认值：Normal
parameters.name: allocation_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of reserved instances. Array length: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 预留实例券ID数组。数组长度：1~100
parameters.name: reserved_instance_id

parameters.help_zh: 预留实例券的状态数组
parameters.name: status

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the reserved instance list
PageNumber.description_zh: 预留实例券列表的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 输入时设置的每页行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of reserved instances
